newsitem.title: USA: LaCrosse Q4 results depend on weather.
newsitem.headline: LaCrosse Q4 results depend on weather.

text.p: LaCrosse Footwear Inc said Friday its order backlogs were higher and fill-in order volume was better at the end of its 1996 third quarter than last year, but weather will still be a factor in fourth quarter results.
"As usual, the results for the fourth quarter will, to some degree, depend on the weather," Patrick Gantert, president and chief executive, said in a statement.
Earlier, the footwear and rainwear company reported third quarter earnings of $0.32 a share versus $0.29 last year.

LaCrosse Footwear said its Rainfair Inc joint venture recently received a $3.0 million order from a new mass merchant account with delivery scheduled for early 1997, and its Red Ball brand product line, acquired in May 1996, is also in development.
"Our marketing plans and product development efforts for 1997 are nearly complete and will include an extensive product line and marketing support for our new Red Ball brand," Gantert said.
